name: Fried Potato Wedges
author: Wikibooks Cookbook contributors

ingredients.item: 4 tbsp of olive oil or (canola oil)
5 g sea salt (paprika or onion salt works too)
4 g of parsley or oregano (many seasonings can work)

steps: Slice potatoes evenly (over-sized wedges can result in uneven cooking).
Sprinkle seasoning and salt over each potato.
Deep fry potato wedges until brown and crispy (cook longer for more crispiness.)
Put in a plastic container and put in fridge (or just put on a cooling area if eating immediately).
